This Mfa Is Filed Under Section 173(1)Of Motor
 Vehicles Act, 1988, Against The Judgment And Award Dated
 30.08.2019 Passed In Mvc No.128/2018 On The File Of The
 Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.X, Hunagund,
 Partly Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation And
 Seeking Enhancement Of Compensation.

 This Appeal Having Been Heard And Reserved For

JUDGMENT
This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 30.08.2019 passed by the tribunal, in MVC No.128/2018 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.

i) Type III compound fracture both bones right Fa with Vascular injury.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13231 ii) Compound fracture of humerus right arm.
iii) Fracture metacarpal 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th fingers rights hand.

5. The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.

Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards pain and suffering.

25,000/-
 2. Towards medical expenses.
Towards transportation 10,000/-

2  5.

Towards food, nourishment, 20,000/-
 attendant charges and  conveyance  6. Towards loss of earning 3,27,600/-
 capacity.
Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by tribunal is on lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

7. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.25,000/- towards pain and suffering,
Rs.50,000/- towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The NC: 2023:KHC-D:13231 compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.2,21,273/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced; therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.30,000/- towards incidental expenses like food, nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.35,250/- (Rs.10,750/- x 3) towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of three months, is awarded.
8. The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered 85% of disability towards right upper limb.
Therefore, considering the evidence of the doctor, 30% functional disability is taken into consideration as the claimant had suffered multiple fractures.
9. The accident is caused in the year 2018.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.11,750/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 44 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 14.

Hence, loss of NC: 2023:KHC-D:13231 future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.3,94,800/- (Rs.11,750/- x 20% x 12 x 14).
10.

Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 25,000/-
 suffering.
 2. Towards medical expenses.

2,21,273/-
 3. Towards loss of amenities.

50,000/-
 4. Towards loss of income 35,250/-
 during laid up period and  medical treatment period.

5. Towards incidental charges 30,000/-
like attendant charges, food, nourishment, conveyance, etc.,.

6. Towards loss of future 3,94,800/- earning capacity.

sentences.text: Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.7,56,323/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till NC: 2023:KHC-D:13231 realization, as against Rs.6,03,873/- awarded by the Tribunal.

12. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 30.08.2019 passed by the Member, M.A.C.T-X,
Hunagund, at Hunagund in MVC No.128/2008 stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.7,56,323/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 107 days in filing the appeal.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13231 vii) No order as to costs.
viii) Draw award accordingly.
